{{Top|leg}}
'''Thriller's Row''' was a narrow street, that was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Hedrett]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. More than twenty drinking establishments and night clubs were located on the street, including the bar [[Crater's]].
